# Sentry Golden Path

> Conservative, production-safe Sentry for front-end apps. Copy-paste guide, not a hosted DSN. Placeholders only: YOUR_ORG, your-app, https://oXXXX.ingest.sentry.io/...

## Docs

- [docs/golden-path.md](docs/golden-path.md): Project, SDK, env, production-only init, source maps, 15-minute checklist
- [docs/observability-map.md](docs/observability-map.md): Golden Signals, front-end SLIs, error budget as release policy
- [docs/sampling.md](docs/sampling.md): sampleRate vs tracesSampleRate vs tracesSampler + inheritOrSampleWith; field Web Vitals
- [docs/pii-and-filters.md](docs/pii-and-filters.md): beforeSend* on-device, no PII breadcrumbs, dataCollection opt-outs
- [docs/domain-tags.md](docs/domain-tags.md): domain + flow tags, short-window dedup
- [docs/ai-llm-monitoring.md](docs/ai-llm-monitoring.md): gen_ai spans, prompts as PII, token/cost breadcrumbs, failure modes, sampling

## Examples

- [examples/react-init.ts](examples/react-init.ts): React SPA init (placeholders)
- [examples/vue-nuxt-init.ts](examples/vue-nuxt-init.ts): Vue 3 / Nuxt client init (placeholders)
- [examples/agent-span.example.ts](examples/agent-span.example.ts): Manual agent/LLM spans (no prompt capture)

## Verify

- `npm ci && npm test`: typecheck examples and fail if Staff premises drift (sampling caps, beforeSend / PII, domain tags, sibling-repo advertising)

## Agent notes

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Constraints for coding agents (source of truth, max 80 lines)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): What belongs in this kit
